contest_effects_info: Here, you can parameter the effects of a move, which will influence the contests system and mechanics activation.
tooltip_info: To get more information about the effects, you can hover over the effect name.
cant_act_anymore_tooltip: Prevents the Pokémon from acting for the rest of the contest.
skip_next_turn_tooltip: Prevents the Pokémon from acting during the next turn.
jam_previous_tooltip: Lowers the Appeal of the previous Pokémon by the Jam value of this move.
jam_all_tooltip: Lowers the Appeal of all previous Pokémon by the Jam value of this move.
jam_same_condition_tooltip: Lowers the Appeal of Pokémon that used a move of the same condition Pokémon by the Jam value of this move.
jam_highest_score_tooltip: Lowers the Appeal of the Pokémon with the highest global score by the Jam value of this move.
more_nervous_tooltip: Doubles the Jam effects received this turn.
try_make_nervous_tooltip: Try to make the remaining Pokémon nervous, forcing them to skip their turn.
compare_previous_appeal_tooltip: Compare the Appeal of this move to the previous Pokémon's, earn no Appeal if it's lower, earn double the Appeal if it's higher, no effect if it's equal.
repeatable_tooltip: Using this move multiple turns in a row does not induce an Appeal loss and still makes the Excitement raise if appliable.
raise_condition_tooltip: Raises the confidence of the Pokémon by 1. Earned Appeal during following turns is raised by 1 per confidence level, 3 max. The Pokémon also becomes less susceptible to nervousness.
lower_others_condition_tooltip: Lowers the confidence level of other Pokémon by 1.
cancel_others_combo_tooltip: If other Pokémon completed a Combo this turn, cancel their Appeal bonus.
play_first_next_turn_tooltip: The Pokémon will play first during the next turn.
play_last_next_turn_tooltip: The Pokémon will play last during the next turn.
randomize_next_turn_order_tooltip: The next turn's order will be randomized.
very_exciting_first_tooltip: If used first, the Excitement will rise by 2.
very_exciting_last_tooltip: If used last, the Excitement will rise by 2.
lock_excitement_tooltip: The Excitement level cannot rise this turn.
always_exciting_tooltip: The Excitement will always rise, regardless of this move or the contest's condition.
can_reset_excitement_tooltip: If this move's conditions does not match with the contest's, the Excitement is reset.
prevent_jam_one_time_tooltip: Prevents the effect of the next Jam this turn.
prevent_jam_one_turn_tooltip: Prevents the effect of all Jams this turn.
bonus_half_previous_appeals_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus equal to half of all previous Appeals.
copy_previous_appeal_tooltip: Earned Appeal is equal to 1 plus the previous Appeal.
bonus_excitement_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus depending on the Excitement level. Bonuses are +0 at 0, 1 or 2 Excitement levels, +2 at 3 Excitement levels, +3 at 4 Excitement levels and +5 at 5 Excitement levels
random_appeal_tooltip: Earns a random Appeal. Possible Appeal values are 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8.
bonus_later_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus the later the move is used. No bonus in first, +1 in 2nd, +3 in 3rd and +5 in last.
bonus_earlier_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus the earlier the move is used. No bonus in last, +1 in 3rd, +3 in 2nd and +5 in first.
bonus_first_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus of 4 when used in first.
bonus_last_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus of 4 when used in last.
bonus_same_condition_previous_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus of 4 if the move is the same condition as the previous Pokémon's.
bonus_raised_condition_tooltip: Earns an Appeal bonus of 2 per confidence level instead of the usual 1.
